Intensity setting for Music (VLM).

- New Intensity option (Settings, or the menu while music plays): Low, Normal or High.
- Loud, bright songs used to push VLM's treble response to its maximum, so the effects ran flat out whatever the music did. Normal now holds them back on those songs so they move with the music again. In testing on a loud pop track, the time the bands spent pinned at maximum dropped from about 75% to under 10% on most of them.
- Low is calmer. High is the old, unrestrained behaviour, a bit livelier still.
- Quieter recordings aren't affected at Normal, and beat detection is unchanged.
